spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (क्षेडयति)
To eat.

m. (-डः)
1 Disease in the ear.
2

Poison.
3
Sound: see क्ष्वेड.

m. (-तः)
Roar of a lion.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A field.
2 The body.
3 A wife.
4 A pure or sacred spot, a place of pilgrimage, as Benares, &c.
5 Plane figure, geometry.
6 A diagram.
E.
क्षि to dwell, &c. affix ष्ट्रन्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Making a field, cultivating it, &c.
E.
क्षेत्र, कर who makes.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Produced in a field, (as corn, &c.)
2 Born of the body, &c.
m. (-जः)
A son, the offspring of the wife by a kinsman or person duly appointed to procreate issue to the husband.
E.
क्षेत्र wife, and ज born, born of the wife only; this is one of the twelve kinds of issue acknowledged by the old Hindu law.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Clever, dexterous, skilful.
2 A husbandman, &c.
m. (-ज्ञः)
1 The soul, the emanation of divinity residing in the body.
2 A libertine, a whore-monger.
E.
क्षेत्र a field, the body, &c. and ज्ञ who knows.

m. (-तिः)
A landowner, a farmer, the master of a field.
E.
क्षेत्र, and पति master.

f. (-मिः)
Cultivated land.
E.
क्षेत्र, and भूमि land.

m. (-विद्)
1 A sage, one who possesses spiritual knowledge.
2 A husbandman.
E.
क्षेत्र, and विद् who knows.

f. (-शिः)
Figurate quantity.
E.
क्षेत्र, and राशि number.

f. (-मा)
The boundaries of a meadow or field, or holy place.
E.
क्षेत्र, and सीमा limit.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
A cultivator, a peasant.
E.
क्षेत्र a field, and जीव who lives, with आङ् prefixed; who gets a livelihood by the labours of the field.

f. (-की)
A plant, commonly Bhūmyāmalakī, (Flacourtia cataphracta, Rox.)

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Having a field, relating to a field, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A farmer, a cultivator.
2 A husband.
E.
क्षेत्र, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि)
Owning or having a field, cultivating it, &c.
m. (-त्री)
1 A husband.
2 A cultivator, a husbandman.
E.
क्षेत्र a field, and इनि aff.

n. (-यं)
1 Meadow grass, herbage, pasturage.
3 Physicking. operating.
m. (-यः)
1 An adulterer.
2 A medicament, what is fit to be administered in medicine.
3 An incurable disease.
E.
क्षेत्र a field, the body, घ aff.

m. (-दः)
Sorrowing, moaning.
E.
क्षि to moan, affix घञ्.

m. (-पः)
1 Sending, dismissing.
2 Throwing, casting.
3 Pride, haughtiness.
4 Delay, dilatoriness.
5 Disrespect, contempt.
6 Passing away time.
7 Abuse, reviling.
8 A clump of flowers, &c.
9 (In arithmetic, &c.) Additive quantity, addendum.
E.
क्षिप to throw, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Who or what throws or sends.
2 Abusing, disrespectful.
E.
क्षिप to throw, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Sending, directing.
2 Throwing, casting.
3 Passing away time.
4 Abusing.
E.
क्षिप to throw, affix ल्युट्.

f. (-णिः or -णी)
1 An oar.
2 A net, a fishing net.
E.
क्षिप to cast or throw, अण and ङीष् affs.

m. (-मा)
Great velocity.
E.
क्षिप्र quick, and इमनिच् affix, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very quick, quickest.
E.
क्षिप्र quick, and इष्ठन् superlative affix, र rejected.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very quick.
E.
क्षिप्र, and ईयसुन् aff.

mfn. (-प्ता-प्ती-प्तृ)
Who or what throws, sends, orders, &c.
E.
क्षिप to throw, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Happy, well, prosperous, right, &c.
mn. (-भः-मं)
1 Happiness, well being.
2 Preserving, protecting, keeping what is acquired.
3 Final emancipation or eternal happiness.
4 The proper term of civil address to a Vaiśya, as क्षेममस्ति, क्षेमं भवतु, Is it well, or may it be well, &c.
f. (-मा)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
क्षि to remove, and मन् Uṇādi affix; what removes or destroys sorrow, &c.

m. (-कः)
A perfume, commonly Cor.
E.
कन् added to क्षेम.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Propitious, conferring happiness or good fortune.
E.
क्षेम, and कृ to make, अच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Auspicious, propitious, conferring happiness or good fortune.
E.
क्षेम happiness, and कृ to make, अण् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Propitious, &c.: see the preceding.
f. (-री)
The Brahmani kite or Coromandel eagle, which is considered as a bird of good omen, (Falco ponticerianus.)
E.
क्षेम, and कृ to make, with खच् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Happy, prosperous.
E.
क्षेम, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-ला)
Opposite leaved fig tree.
E.
क्षेम auspicious, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
1 Luckly, prosperous, thriving.
2 Healthy, salubrious.
E.
क्षेम, and यत् added.

(उ) क्षेवु r. 1st cl. (क्षेवति)
To spit, to eject from the mouth.
